Released: 09/03/2025
Home
TAISE Curriculum Overview
The Trusted AI Safety Expert (TAISE) Curriculum provides the official course outlines for CSA’s groundbreaking AI safety credential. This detailed framework spans 10 modules covering foundation AI knowledge, generative AI architectures, applies use cases, ethics and transparency, governance, lifecycle risks, cloud and data security, continuous adapatation practices, and more.
Designed with global standards in mind (including NIST AI RMF, ISO, and CSA’s own AI Controls Matrix), the curriculum highlights both technical depth and organizational safeguards.
By exploring key challenges such as bias, explainability, and more, the TAISE curriculum equips professionals to manage AI responsibly from concept to deployment. This document servies as the roadmap for learners preparing to become certified as leaders in trustworthy AI.
